decisions.reason: As a safety shoe line it sits at the core of the firm's footwear knowledge, and its move from a general mention in 2023 to its own page in 2024 suggests enough traction for further learning and refinement.

A comfort insole is closely related to the firm's footwear and fitting capabilities, but because it was only mentioned rather than strongly featured in both years it looks more tentative and therefore carries a moderate discontinuation risk.

This supportive insole also fits the firm's existing know-how and service offering, yet the limited web prominence and overlap with other insole solutions imply a somewhat higher chance of portfolio rationalisation than for the core shoe products.

An ergonomic safety shoe series is highly aligned with the firm's established competencies and innovation path, and being presented on its own page in both years indicates sustained commitment and market relevance.

Firefighter and rescue boots extend the firm's protective footwear expertise into a specialised but related field, and the upgrade to a dedicated page in 2024 points to growing acceptance rather than likely withdrawal.

The moulded insole is strongly embedded in the firm's footwear, foot-measurement and training capabilities, and its repeated home-page visibility plus a named customer application signal very strong prospects for retention.
